q: Which of the following is the correct statement of the Heine-Borel theorem in ℝⁿ?
opts: A subset of ℝⁿ is compact if and only if it is closed and bounded
Every open cover of a closed set has a finite subcover
exp: In ℝⁿ, the Heine-Borel theorem characterises compact sets precisely as those that are both closed and bounded. This fails in infinite-dimensional spaces.
